title: Design: Inactive tag in the Issue Credit list looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a paid part sale, part sale 1, that sold part A and part B, with part A set inactive after the sale and part B still active.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 6.7 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Part Sales page.
custom_steps:
1. Click part sale 1.
  2. Click the Finance tab.
  3. Click the three-dot menu of the invoice.
  4. Click Issue Credit.
  5. Tick Parts are being returned.
  6. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part sale 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The invoice shows.

Step 3:

  • The invoice menu opens with Issue Credit in it.

Step 4:

  • The Issue Credit window opens.

Step 5:

  • The "Parts to return" list shows parts A and B.
  • Part A's row shows a small grey rounded "Inactive" tag right after its part number, before its description.
  • Part B's row has no tag.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and no credit is issued.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R13: “A credit on any invoice, from a part sale or a work order, lists the parts sold on the invoice, active or inactive. A part that is now inactive carries the grey "Inactive" tag beside its part number.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "6.7 Part sale credit: still offered, tagged". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above where the PRD speaks, and from the board pictures where it is silent about the look.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • daily-07-p6-6-credit-tag.png

The design's own words:

  • “Issue Credit on part sale P2-89 lists the parts sold, active or inactive. N79L-063 is now inactive and carries the grey "Inactive" tag beside its part number. Credits on work order invoices work the same way (S9-R13).”
